response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web developer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang backgrounds, but he does not meet several hard requirements: no native-level Japanese proficiency (a required qualification), minimal C/UNIX systems programming (a brief stint at National Instruments a decade ago), and no demonstrated Linux kernel analysis or modification experience. His career trajectory centers on web platforms, GIS, and ad-tech rather than embedded networking, LAN switches, or security technologies like MACsec, 802.1X, or tamper detection.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software development experience across web, mobile, and backend systems
Some low-level and performance-oriented experience (C/C++ at National Instruments, low-latency DLang services)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed — native-level Japanese is a hard requirement
No embedded networking, LAN-switch, or security-protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF)
No Linux kernel investigation or source-code modification experience; C proficiency appears dated and limited
